generated.what_happened: Nationwide student protests have escalated across French high schools and universities over poor campus conditions, spending cuts, and persistent teacher shortages. While largely peaceful, the demonstrations and school blockades have involved localized violence, injuries to both staff and protesters, and thousands of arrests. In response, the French government announced an emergency plan costing several dozen million euros to deploy roughly 3,000 qualified teachers to fill critical staffing gaps. Despite this concession, student and teacher unions have pledged to maintain their movement and called for another round of nationwide strikes.
